Experts strongly recommend multicomponent cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (abbreviated CBT-I) for adults who have chronic insomnia. The American Academy of Sleep Medicine (the professional organization of sleep medicine specialists) strongly recommends CBT-I.

reply: When folks talk about wellness they usually split it into a few “dimensions.” The emotional side is all about how you cope with life, feel satisfied in your relationships and handle your feelings – things like being able to notice what you’re feeling, being kind to yourself and bouncing back when stuff gets tough. The physical side is more about the body: getting enough sleep, eating nourishing foods, staying active and looking after any health issues. They’re not totally separate; the two feed each other. question: do those blue light blocking glasses actually do anything for sleep or is it a scam
